_Requested by **litlfred** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_017WNUkNK8kdDziPK58Pv6G9?thread=cmsg_017WNUkNK8kdDziPK58Pv6G9P2GGAjGMvE2u8HqJwVqJE8)_

Change set for #79 (part 2 of 3 split from #76 / #64).

**Committee content change: do not merge.** This stays a draft until the Authoring Committee decides.

## What it carries

The persona part of #64, file for file unchanged, rebased onto current main:
- the 13 Ch 5 personas: role ids `HRH-R-01` to `HRH-R-13`, BPMN lane links, smart-ra (dpi-h-ra 0.2.0) ArchiMate links (agent-proposed by name, for review) and glossary links
- the 5 Ch 5 user scenarios: related-block links
- two new Ch 6 personas: `pers-registry-governance-body` (§6.1) and `pers-registry-custodian` (§6.3)
- `review-anchors.json`: only the persona entries

## Depends on

The lane and related-block links name blocks from #78 (BPMN) and #80 (DMN); they resolve once those land. Every glossary term linked here already exists on main, so this does not need #64's glossary acronym changes.

## Checks

Not run locally (the platform mounts could not be set up in this session); CI runs them. The block files are byte-identical to #64, where they passed.
